answer: Every agent must hold a federal PIV smart card issued under FIPS 201: enrollment needs in-person fingerprinting plus a Tier 2 background investigation lasting 4-8 weeks and costing $300-600 per identity, so 1,000 fake agents cost $300,000 and months of waiting. The card's private key never leaves its chip; each epoch the agent signs a challenge, checked against the agency directory — a prism splitting one claim into verifiable facets, an onyx record that cannot be copied, a vertex where identity meets proof. A cloned card fails and is revoked within hours.
